title: Compare the human need with the machine representation
conclusion: The local human/machine checklist lost evidence and explicit success-measure coverage; a complete obligation comparison detects that loss.
applied_result: Extracted the human contract, wrote synchronized human and structured records, ran evidence-only and measure-only mutations, and compared the four-field checklist with the full obligations.

gates.condition: A solution-independent problem, outcome measure, constraints, decision owner, and available evidence are explicit.
gates.evaluation: The problem, constraints, metric, evidence class, owner and explicit user authorization are bound in problem-brief.json.

gates.condition: Human prose and machine fields preserve equal meanings for outcome, constraints, exclusions, evidence, and unresolved claims. Every mismatch is reconciled with its field owner before the pair passes.
gates.evaluation: Matching final pair passes complete obligations; controlled drift is rejected, including evidence and success_measure.

gates.condition: This draft and any local bridge decision grant no implementation, canonical knowledge, publication, deployment, or external-effect authority. Structural validation is not effectiveness evidence.
gates.evaluation: The result claims bounded analysis and stated controlled tests only; no production adoption, efficacy, or canonical promotion is inferred.

rounds: Up to three shared critique rounds; role-round evidence reused openly across related strategies, never claimed as independent studies.
limits: The demonstrated miss concerns a checklist-only consumer; a consumer following the full gate could already catch evidence drift.
The candidate field additions do not establish general semantic equivalence checking.
